SELECT * FROM ( SELECT M.MESSAGE_ID, M.SENDER_NO, M.RECEIVER_NO, M.PRODUCT_ID, M.CONTENT, M.IS_READ, M.CREATED_AT, U.NICKNAME,P.TITLE,P.STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY M.PRODUCT_ID, M.SENDER_NO ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC) AS RN FROM MESSAGES M JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_NO = M.SENDER_NO JOIN PRODUCTS P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = M.PRODUCT_ID WHERE M.RECEIVER_NO = #{myNo} AND M.RECEIVER_DELETED =0
) WHERE RN =1 ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT M.MESSAGE_ID, M.SENDER_NO, M.RECEIVER_NO, M.PRODUCT_ID, m.content, m.is_read, m.created_at, u.nickname AS opponent_nickname, p.title AS product_title, p.status AS product_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY m.product_id, m.receiver_no ORDER BY m.created_at DESC ) AS rn FROM MESSAGES m JOIN USERS u ON u.user_no = m.receiver_no JOIN PRODUCTS p ON p.product_id = m.product_id WHERE m.sender_no = #{myNo} AND m.sender_deleted = 0 ) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
